census.vintage: 2020-2024 American Community Survey 5-year estimates (Census Bureau, released December 2025)

tables.B25058: Median contract rent (dollars per month, renter-occupied units paying cash rent)
tables.B25064: Median gross rent (contract rent plus estimated utilities and fuels)
tables.B25077: Median value of owner-occupied housing units (owner-reported)
tables.B25103: Median real estate taxes paid (dollars per year, owner-occupied units)
tables.B25113: Median gross rent by year householder moved into unit (the 2023 or later column is used for new-lease rents)
tables.B25109: Median value by year householder moved into unit (the 2023 or later column is used for recent purchases)

census.note: Property tax rate is the median real estate taxes paid divided by the median home value for the same place.

bea.vintage: 2024 Regional Price Parities (Bureau of Economic Analysis, released February 2026)
bea.note: Indexes use the United States = 100. Goods are used for groceries and transportation; Services: Other for healthcare; Services: Housing for housing; Services: Utilities for utilities.
